description: This file is a PHP source code for a web interface page that allows editing wireless network configuration settings, including SSID, security mode, channels, and other Wi-Fi parameters. It includes PHP logic, embedded JavaScript, and HTML form elements.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog for selecting Wi-Fi security modes, with options for WEP, WPA, WPA2, and handling user confirmation.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Collects form data, constructs a JSON configuration, and sends an AJAX request to save wireless network settings.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Sends an AJAX request to reset or restore Wi-Fi settings based on provided info.

methods.name: init_form
methods.description: Initializes form elements based on current configuration, user permissions, and device capabilities, including setting default selections and enabling/disabling inputs.
